# HyperTracker API Docs

## HyperTracker API

- [HyperTracker API Documentation](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/hypertracker-api-documentation.md): Unlock a complete data foundation for any trading, analytics, or intelligence product, powered by the trusted team behind CoinMarketMan and HyperTracker.
- [Why HyperTracker](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/why-hypertracker.md): Built to earn trust through experience, HyperTracker combines years of proven development with a purpose-driven approach to on-chain data.
- [API Dashboard - How to Use](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/api-dashboard-how-to-use.md): Monitor your key, usage, performance, and billing in one place.
- [Endpoints](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/endpoints.md): Everything you need to get started with our API
- [HyperTracker State Check](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/endpoints/hypertracker-state-check.md): Check the freshness and processing status of HyperTracker data.
- [Trader & Wallet Data](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/endpoints/trader-and-wallet-data.md)
- [Positions & Market Data](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/endpoints/positions-and-market-data.md)
- [Cohort Intelligence](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/endpoints/cohort-intelligence.md)
- [Position Heatmap](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/endpoints/position-heatmap.md): This is the data behind the HyperTracker Position Heatmap, showing how each coin is positioned across trader cohorts, including long/short bias.
- [Order Data](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/endpoints/order-data.md): The raw order data powering HyperTracker Market Radar. Track global open orders, liquidity, and order clusters across Hyperliquid.
- [Liquidation Data](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/endpoints/liquidation-data.md)
- [Leaderboards](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/endpoints/leaderboards.md)
- [Builder Analytics](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/endpoints/builder-analytics.md): APIs for accessing real-time builder performance, revenue, and user activity across the Hyperliquid ecosystem.
- [Stats Page Data](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/endpoints/stats-page-data.md): Endpoints powering the Stats page on the HyperTracker dashboard.
- [Hyperliquid Info Endpoints](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/endpoints/hyperliquid-info-endpoints.md): Granular ecosystem data, simplified.
- [Perpetuals](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/endpoints/hyperliquid-info-endpoints/perpetuals.md): Dedicated endpoints for perpetual asset contexts and margin tables.
- [Spot](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/endpoints/hyperliquid-info-endpoints/spot.md): Dedicated endpoints for spot market metadata and user token states.
- [Rate Limits & Pricing](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/endpoints/rate-limits-and-pricing.md)
- [Anything missing?](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/endpoints/anything-missing.md): If you need additional endpoints, data points, or functionality that isn't currently available in the API, feel free to reach out.
- [Real-Time Websocket Streams](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/real-time-websocket-streams.md): HyperTracker provides custom real-time WebSocket streams for teams that need low-latency access to Hyperliquid market, order, fill, and wallet-level data.
- [Webhooks](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/webhooks.md): Stay in sync with effortless, automated data updates.
- [LLM HyperTracker Skill](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/llm-hypertracker-skill.md): Give Your LLM Hyperliquid Intelligence
- [Daily market brief: everything that matters in 60 seconds](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/llm-hypertracker-skill/daily-market-brief-everything-that-matters-in-60-seconds.md)
- [Follow Today’s Top-Earning Traders and Copy Their Moves](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/llm-hypertracker-skill/follow-todays-top-earning-traders-and-copy-their-moves.md)
- [Identify the wallet behind a Hyperliquid PnL share card](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/llm-hypertracker-skill/identify-the-wallet-behind-a-hyperliquid-pnl-share-card.md)
- [Find which coin the entire market is on the wrong side of](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/llm-hypertracker-skill/find-which-coin-the-entire-market-is-on-the-wrong-side-of.md)
- [Bring Your Next Vibe-Coded Trading Tool to Life](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/llm-hypertracker-skill/bring-your-next-vibe-coded-trading-tool-to-life.md): Drop your idea and we will add the sharpest ones to the library.
- [API Usage Examples](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/api-usage-examples.md): Explore practical, copy ready examples that show how to combine HyperTracker endpoints into real product features.
- [Level 1: Personal Portfolio Auditor & Account Dashboard](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/api-usage-examples/level-1-personal-portfolio-auditor-and-account-dashboard.md): Programmatically aggregate performance metrics across your master wallet and sub-accounts while bypassing public endpoint rate limits.
- [Level 2: Alpha Screener & Trader Due Diligence Tool](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/api-usage-examples/level-2-alpha-screener-and-trader-due-diligence-tool.md): Programmatically scan the network leaderboard, isolate high-performing addresses, and perform deep risk due diligence before copying or tracking top traders.
- [Level 3: Macro Sentiment & Smart Money Cohort Radar](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/api-usage-examples/level-3-macro-sentiment-and-smart-money-cohort-radar.md): Segment the entire network into performance-based trader cohorts and track rolling macro long/short bias trends across major assets.
- [Level 4: Systematic Exposure Analyst & Backtesting Pipeline](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/api-usage-examples/level-4-systematic-exposure-analyst-and-backtesting-pipeline.md): Ingest historical position timelines and cross-reference them with macro leverage expansion to backtest exposure models and automate database synchronization.
- [Level 5: Structural Order Flow & Liquidation Cluster Mapper](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/api-usage-examples/level-5-structural-order-flow-and-liquidation-cluster-mapper.md): Stream live execution flows via private WebSockets and parse rolling order book snapshots to map forced liquidation cascades and institutional liquidity block movements.
- [Connect With Us](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/connect-with-us.md): Stay connected with the HyperTracker ecosystem and access everything you need in one place.

## HyperTracker Dashboard

- [About](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/hypertracker-dashboard/about.md): Real time intelligence for Hyperliquid, built from scratch.
- [Segmentation](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/hypertracker-dashboard/segmentation.md): Two simple cohort systems that reveal who is moving the market, and how well they are doing.
- [Bias](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/hypertracker-dashboard/bias.md): A single score that captures direction and conviction, from one wallet to an entire cohort.
- [Support](https://docs.coinmarketman.com/hypertracker-dashboard/support.md): Help us improve HyperTracker with sharp feedback, clear requests, and real examples.

# Agent Instructions
This documentation is published with GitBook. GitBook is the documentation platform designed so that both humans and AI agents can read, navigate, and reason over technical content effectively. Learn more at gitbook.com.

## Querying This Documentation
If you need additional information, you can query the documentation dynamically by asking a question.
Perform an HTTP GET request on a page URL with the `ask` query parameter:
```
GET https://docs.coinmarketman.com/hypertracker-api-documentation.md?ask=<question>
```
The question should be specific, self-contained, and written in natural language.
The response will contain a direct answer to the question and relevant excerpts and sources from the documentation.
Use this mechanism when the answer is not explicitly present in the current page, you need clarification or additional context, or you want to retrieve related documentation sections.
